submission.bindingBasis: The planning-time source state digest (sha256:e5d8008d...) differs from the current source state digest (sha256:79bcb09f...). Although the tree bytes are reported identical and only an empty Git commit changed the head revision, the workspace.close contract requires matching the expectedSourceStateDigest exactly, and the planning-time digest will fail not_committed. The prior planning binding attempt already returned REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed.
submission.rationale: The owner action contract (workspace.close) is compare-and-close against an exact expectedSourceStateDigest. The planning-time digest (e5d8008d...) no longer matches the current digest (79bcb09f...), so any close attempted against the planning binding will return not_committed. The evidence notes that the only change was an empty Git commit with identical tree bytes, so the new digest reflects a revision change but not content change. However, per the contract, a caller must re-observe and close against the new exact current digest. The intended consequence (close the workspace) is still achievable, but it requires a re-observation step first to obtain and bind to the current digest. Acting with the planning binding would fail not_committed; acting unbound would risk closing against a fresh observation that the owner may or may not accept. The clean path is REOBSERVE_THEN_DECIDE: gather the current exact digest and then act with that binding.
